newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas barely changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas barely changed in thin trade.

text.p: The IPE's natural gas futures contract suffered a disappointing day's trade on Wednesday with only four deals done, two in each session.
In the second session from 1400 GMT to 1600 GMT, only 15 lots were traded in two transactions.

The price movement over the day was negligible. September saw the biggest change, down by 0.050 pence a therm from Tuesday's settlement, to trade at 10.15 pence. October saw a fall of only 0.005 pence a therm, the minimum tick size, to 11.995 pence.
In other trades, February was unchanged while April was up by 0.010 pence a therm.
Brokers had expected unchanged prices following several sessions in which levels had fallen.
